TypeScript 7 is the native (Go) port which does not yet expose the full compiler API used by @typescript-eslint, ts-jest, ts-loader and ts-node. #1697 auto-merged the v7 bump and broke the lint stage on master (ESLint crash: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading Cjs)'). Hold on v6 until the toolchain supports the native port.
